content.value:
.Calculate the generating cost per kWh delivered from a power station using the following 11   
data:   
Plant capacity =100 MW   
Annual load factor = 45%   
Capital cost = Tk 105 crores   
Annual cost of wages, taxation etc. = Tk 40 lac   
Cost of fuel, lubrication, maintenance etc. = Tk 1/kWh generated   
Interest = 4% per annum   
Depreciation = 6% per annum of initial value
